ClinicalDocument.title: SYNTHETIC RECORD, NOT A REAL MEDICAL RECORD — Progress Note 5 — Annual Wellness Visit, Subsequent — Albert Einstein

text.paragraph: Subsequent annual wellness visit; no new complaints. [S]

Mr. Einstein is a 70-year-old man with a 5.0 cm abdominal aortic aneurysm under surveillance, hypertension, and aortic atherosclerosis, who comes for his subsequent annual wellness visit six weeks after his three-month review. He completed the health risk assessment himself. The back strain in June settled within ten days. He has had no tobacco since his quit date in the spring, now uses the 7 mg patch and an occasional lozenge, and still sometimes holds an empty, unlit pipe while he thinks. His home blood pressure readings average 122/74. He takes amlodipine, losartan, atorvastatin, and aspirin without side effects. He walks to and from his office most days and has had no falls, emergency visits, or hospital stays this year. [S]

Follow-up: Six-month aneurysm surveillance visit with duplex ultrasound in four weeks. Influenza and COVID-19 vaccines next month. Second zoster dose and Tdap in two to six months. Return the stool test kit within two weeks; the hepatitis C result will be sent by letter. Next annual wellness visit in one year. Next scheduled visit 2026-09-22: six-month aneurysm surveillance with duplex ultrasound. [S]

Advance care planning was discussed as part of the wellness visit. He completed a health care agent form; the agent is recorded in the chart and not named here. He said that he wants to make his own medical decisions for as long as he can, with plain numbers in front of him, and that what matters most to him is being able to keep working and walking. On the aneurysm, he repeated what he agreed with vascular surgery in April: he would consider endovascular repair if it reaches the threshold, and wants the decision reviewed with him at each scan rather than settled in advance. No treatment limits were recorded, and he will revisit the plan at next year's visit or sooner if his health changes. [S]
